title: projectOverviewPresentation
responsibility: Formats tracker card labels, groups, filters, dates, and contextual text for Project Overview.

inputs.name: stateLabel.state
inputs.description: The current state of one project.

inputs.name: statusLabel.status
inputs.description: The status of one tracker item.

inputs.name: isCompact.state
inputs.description: The current state of one project.

inputs.name: countOf.count
inputs.description: The numeric count used to select a singular or plural label.

inputs.name: countOf.one
inputs.description: The label used for one matching entry.

inputs.name: countOf.many
inputs.description: The label used for zero or multiple matching entries.

inputs.name: headline.cards
inputs.description: The display-ready projects considered for a filter, band, count, or item detail.

inputs.name: totalsLine.projects
inputs.description: The number of displayed projects.

inputs.name: totalsLine.liveSessions
inputs.description: The total of running tracker sessions represented by the relevant projects.

inputs.name: filterChips.cards
inputs.description: The display-ready projects considered for a filter, band, count, or item detail.

inputs.name: visibleCards.cards
inputs.description: The display-ready projects considered for a filter, band, count, or item detail.

inputs.name: visibleCards.filter
inputs.description: The selected project state or All.

inputs.name: bandsFor.cards
inputs.description: The display-ready projects considered for a filter, band, count, or item detail.

inputs.name: etaFor.item
inputs.description: Overview item carrying its current work label, Tracker status and optional due time.

inputs.name: etaFor.now
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds used to compare tracker timestamps.

inputs.name: formatWhen.iso
inputs.description: The ISO timestamp to display.

inputs.name: inProgressItems.items
inputs.description: The work items to filter for in-progress status.

inputs.name: sessionsText.liveSessions
inputs.description: The total of running tracker sessions represented by the relevant projects.

inputs.name: countsText.counts
inputs.description: The counts for the project’s displayed tracker statuses.

inputs.name: surfacedContext.cards
inputs.description: The display-ready projects considered for a filter, band, count, or item detail.

inputs.name: surfacedContext.item
inputs.description: The tracker item being visited or checked for display.

inputs.name: projectOf.cards
inputs.description: The display-ready projects considered for a filter, band, count, or item detail.

inputs.name: projectOf.item
inputs.description: The tracker item being visited or checked for display.

outputs.name: stateLabel
outputs.description: The readable label for the project state.

outputs.name: statusLabel
outputs.description: The readable label for the tracker item status.

outputs.name: isCompact
outputs.description: Whether to render the compact card for a quiet or done project.

outputs.name: countOf
outputs.description: A count followed by the corresponding singular or plural label.

outputs.name: headline
outputs.description: The overview heading based on projects waiting on Daniel.

outputs.name: totalsLine
outputs.description: The counts of visible projects and live sessions.

outputs.name: filterChips
outputs.description: The available filters and the number of projects in each.

outputs.name: visibleCards
outputs.description: The cards matching the selected filter, in their original order.

outputs.name: bandsFor
outputs.description: The visible cards grouped into attention, active, quiet, and done sections.

outputs.name: etaFor
outputs.description: The due-state label and tone for the current time.

outputs.name: formatWhen
outputs.description: A readable time label for the tracker timestamp.

outputs.name: inProgressItems
outputs.description: The input work items with in-progress status.

outputs.name: sessionsText
outputs.description: The readable live-session count for one project.

outputs.name: countsText
outputs.description: A readable summary of the nonzero tracker status counts.

outputs.name: surfacedContext
outputs.description: The matching question or blocked reason, or null when neither applies.

outputs.name: projectOf
outputs.description: The project name for the selected task, or null after the item disappears.
